# Clairo Care

> Clairo Care LLC is a provider agency for people with intellectual and developmental
> disabilities. We serve Maryland through the Developmental Disabilities Administration (DDA) and
> Pennsylvania through the Office of Developmental Programs (ODP). Families and participants stay
> involved in choosing who provides care, and Clairo carries the employment, payroll, training,
> billing, and compliance behind it.

Services we deliver under a participant's approved plan: Personal Supports, Personal Supports
Enhanced, Community Development Services, and Nursing Supports. Employment Supports is coming
soon. Which services a participant can receive depends on their plan and authorizations.

The model: Clairo built its own software so the administrative work takes fewer people, and the
saving goes to caregiver pay. Caregivers you already trust, including qualified family and friends
where DDA rules permit, can often apply to work through Clairo and keep supporting the same person.

- [How It Works](https://www.clairo.care/how-it-works): the six steps from first conversation to starting services.

- [Self-Directed Services](https://www.clairo.care/self-directed-services): three paths for families who self-direct today.
- [Waiver Services](https://www.clairo.care/waiver-services): the four IDD waiver services Clairo provides.
- [Caregivers](https://www.clairo.care/caregivers): what it is like to work at Clairo and how to apply.
- [Wages and Benefits](https://www.clairo.care/wages-and-benefits): published pay ranges, mileage, health benefits, and paid time off.
- [About](https://www.clairo.care/about): why Clairo exists and the principles it is built on.
- [FAQ](https://www.clairo.care/faq): straight answers for families and caregivers.
- [Talk to Clairo](https://www.clairo.care/contact): the contact form and official contact details.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.clairo.care/privacy): what the website and the CareBridge apps collect.

CareBridge is the app Clairo caregivers, families, and office staff use for schedules, shifts, and
care records. It is not a public product.

## Please note

Eligibility, wages, services, and what can move to a provider agency all depend on the
participant's plan, authorizations, applicable DDA or ODP requirements, and individual
circumstances. Nothing on this site is regulatory guidance.
